record: Mark R. Barnes, National Historic Landmark Nomination, sections 7 and 10
facts: Rubble walls with brick vaulting, red plaster and white trim, two projecting west bastions, east salient, vaulted west and south passages, staircases, detached cistern and one-storey flat paved decks. The 1976 work restored the flat roof of the taller west wing. Courtyard window heads alternate triangular and curved forms on the center five upper bays.

record: National Park Service Fort Frederik site history
facts: The trapezoid-shaped Danish fort includes diamond bastions to the northwest and southwest and a triangular east salient. Reference is architectural text only.
